requirements.evidence: Contract and core rules are implemented: app/Enums/CallMode.php:6-9 (three string-backed cases), app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php:8 (extends RuntimeException), app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:22-27 (queue row locked inside the transaction, fresh is_active read), :98-117 (queue scoping, only waiting, priority DESC/issued_at ASC/id ASC, normals oldest-first), :78-92 (last-3 fairness history), :60-65 (marks only status/called_at/called_by_user_id and returns the refreshed ticket), :68 (NoWaitingTicketsException). Gap: the fairness decision at :33-41 is a pre-lock snapshot and is not re-evaluated after concurrent candidates are skipped.

conventions.evidence: Uses the project's Action pattern and keeps docs in sync (docs/business-rules.md:101, docs/architecture.md:103, CHANGELOG.md:12), with Pest feature tests under tests/Feature. Deviation: the public __invoke at app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:17 has no PHPDoc, although the private helpers at :78 and :98 do and conventions ask for PHPDoc on touched public methods.

security.evidence: No untrusted input is involved: typed Queue/User/CallMode parameters (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:17), the caller is trusted per task, and attributes are assigned individually at :60-63 instead of mass-assigning request data; no secrets, output or Blade code are touched. Authorization is explicitly out of scope in task.md.

tests.evidence: Fifteen Pest cases cover ordering/ties (tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php:47-74), queue scoping and no re-call (:76-92), all three modes and their failure paths (:94-134), empty queue (:136-141), fairness trigger/reset/mode-history/no-normal/fewer-than-3 (:143-218), inactive and stale queue (:220-242), and the return contract (:244-261). Missing: direct coverage of the exactly-once skip/re-check branch and of the write-once field set.

simplicity.evidence: The 119-line action delegates to two small private helpers (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:78 and :98) and reuses the existing InactiveQueueException, TicketStatus and Ticket model rather than adding layers or duplicate abstractions.

readability.evidence: Focused methods with clear names (priorityStreakReached, orderedCandidateIds), and comments explain the locking/race reasoning (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:20-23 and :43-45); no dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: Only task-related files change: CHANGELOG.md, app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php, app/Enums/CallMode.php, app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php, docs/architecture.md, docs/business-rules.md and tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php; no unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: The fairness restriction is decided once from a pre-lock snapshot; if the only waiting normal ticket is claimed through Ticket::call() before its row lock, the loop skips it and throws NoWaitingTicketsException even though priority tickets are still eligible in any mode, which rule 6 does not allow.

No test exercises the exactly-once candidate skip/re-check branch (requirement 7) or asserts that only status, called_at and called_by_user_id change, so that core concurrency behavior is verified only by reading the code.
The fairness-trigger test has only one waiting normal, so the rule that the oldest normal is called is not pinned by a second normal candidate.
The public __invoke method lacks a PHPDoc block, contrary to the project convention to document touched public methods.

review.summary: Adds the CallNextTicket domain action with the CallMode enum and NoWaitingTicketsException, implementing deterministic queue-scoped selection, the 3-call fairness rule, inactive-queue rejection and per-candidate locking, with matching docs and a thorough Pest feature test. The implementation meets the contract and most edge cases, but the fairness decision is not re-evaluated after concurrent skips and the exactly-once skip path is untested, so the PR is approvable with minor fixes.
